description: Start the observer (or reuse the running one) and check that no other session is open in this project. The observer is mandatory: it is the single source of truth for which agent session works in a project, and a project has at most one open session. Call it at every session start, after reporting `session_started` through aide_observer_event on its own and reading that reply; call it once more when a report replies `observer not running`. It takes no arguments. One observer serves every project on this machine: it tries AIDE_OBSERVER_PORT first if set, then 24680 to 24689 in order, takes the first free port and records it. The first line of the reply starts with exactly one of: `Observer running at <link>` or `Observer already running at <link>` (go on), `Observer not replaced: …` (an older observer still serves at the link; go on), `HALT: …` (another session of this project is open — each line names its id, or `claude:<id>` for a Claude session that never reported, whether it is working or waiting on the user, how long it has been quiet with `maybe stuck` past 15 minutes, its last activity, pipeline and phase; this is a hard stop: tell the user, and proceed only after they approve ending that session with aide_observer_end_session and a new start passes, or they close this one), or `BLOCKED: …` (the observer could not start on any port, every port tried is named; a hard stop: tell the user and do nothing further). Give the user the link, which includes its access token.
name: aide_observer_start
